result: Targets widely spaced; no direct hits reported
note: "During the night of 5 Jul., our heaviest bomber forces attacked ship targets and harbor installations at Bizerta ... No direct hits were reported. Thirteen planes failed to return." The diary names no unit. I./KG 76, at Foggia since mid-May, "raided Bizerte on 6 July" (Wikipedia, Kampfgeschwader 76, citing de Zeng, Stankey and Creek 2008, pp. 234-235; secondary): one of the units, not the whole force. Battery B, 62nd CA, "brought down one JU 88" at 0400 on 6 July (rg64-427181738/p0663).

result: 1 cruiser and 10 freighters hit and more or less heavily damaged
note: "On the night of 6 Aug. 220 of our bombers were sent out against Bizerta. 1 cruiser and 10 freighters were hit and more or less heavily damaged" (8 Aug entry; the sentence runs onto p111). II./KG 76 (Foggia) "on 7 August attacked shipping and installations at Bizerte" and I./KG 6 "carried out a raid on Bizerte harbour" on 7 August (Wikipedia, Kampfgeschwader 76 and 6, citing de Zeng et al. 2007-2008; secondary; the night of 6/7 August). I./KG 6's airfield is not given there.

result: Hits on 25 vessels of about 108,000 GRT (claimed)
